info.title: Wildforce API
info.description:
API for Wildforce mobile clients. Authenticate with a Sanctum bearer token,
then use the sync endpoints to exchange user-owned records.

post.description: Stores a PNG at `avatars/{user-id}.png` in the public `wildfit` Supabase bucket.

post.description: Stores a JPEG on the default private S3 disk and updates the matching photo path on the session.

get.description: Streams the stored JPEG inline. Available to the session owner, their active coaches, and administrators.

post.summary: Analyse private body progress photos
post.description: Analyses the already uploaded private front and/or profile photos for the session. No image is sent in this request. The result is an estimate only and not medical advice.

post.summary: Upload a private nutrition log entry image
post.description: Stores a JPEG on the default private S3 disk and links it to the nutrition log entry through a `localPhoto` media record. An existing `localPhoto` media record is reused; any other media (e.g. remote) is left untouched and replaced by a new record.

404.description: Nutrition log entry does not belong to the authenticated user.

get.summary: Download a private nutrition log entry image
get.description: Streams the entry's `localPhoto` JPEG inline. Available to the entry owner, their active coaches, and administrators.

404.description: The entry is not visible to the authenticated user, or it has no stored image.

post.summary: Sync an App Store transaction
post.description: Verifies a StoreKit 2 signed transaction (JWS) and creates or updates the authenticated user's App Store subscription.

post.description: Verifies a Google Play subscription purchase token and creates or updates the authenticated user's Google Play subscription. The obfuscated account ID must match the one set on the purchase.

post.summary: Generate and save a one-week workout plan
post.description: Generates and persists a workout plan from the authenticated user's training profile and recent history. The response uses the sync payload, including IDs and timestamps.

post.summary: Generate a single workout day draft
post.description: Generates one workout day from the request and the authenticated user's profile. The draft is not persisted, so the response has no IDs or timestamps; save it through the workout-day sync flow.

post.summary: Adapt a workout day to another training location
post.description: Generates a copy of the workout day adapted to the equipment at one of the workout owner's training locations, preserving its focus, movement patterns, difficulty, warmup/cooldown sections, and duration where practical. The original workout day is not changed and the draft is not persisted, so the response has no IDs or timestamps; once the user confirms, replace the workout day's content through the workout-day sync flow. The workout owner, an admin, or the owner's active coach may call it.

training_location_id.description: A training location owned by the workout day's user.

403.description: The user cannot update this workout day, an active subscription, trial, or demo access is required (code `subscription_required`), or AI features are disabled for this account (code `ai_blocked`).

404.description: The workout day does not exist.

409.description: The idempotency key is already in progress or was reused with a different request.

429.description: The generation rate limit of five requests per minute was exceeded. Also returned with code `ai_budget_exceeded` and a `resets_at` timestamp when the monthly AI budget is spent.

post.summary: Generate and save a seven-day nutrition plan
post.description: Generates and persists a nutrition plan from the authenticated user's nutrition profile, body metrics, training preferences, and upcoming workout plan. Maintenance calories default to a formula estimate (Mifflin-St Jeor BMR times the lifestyle multiplier plus 2% per training day, capped at 12%). When the client sends optional Apple Health `daily_energy`, the server uses the 21 most recent days instead: it drops days without basal energy, trims the lowest and highest tenth once seven or more days remain, and averages the rest. With at least 10 days covering 70% of the 21-day window it uses that average. With at least 5 days covering 40% it blends the average with the formula estimate, weighting Apple Health by its coverage clamped to 35-65%. Otherwise it uses the formula. Calorie guardrails always come from the formula estimate. The response uses the same sync payload as the nutrition-plan sync endpoints.

post.description: Estimates the foods, gram amounts, and macronutrients of a meal from a free-text description. Text fields are written in the authenticated user's preferred language. Nothing is persisted; store the estimate through the nutrition-log sync flow.

post.summary: Contribute a product to Open Food Facts
post.description: Submits a user-provided food product, nutrition information, and front and nutrition-label images to Open Food Facts. The request is authenticated, requires active app access, and is idempotent.

post.summary: Push changed records for a registered resource

get.summary: Pull changed records for a registered resource
get.description:
Returns the records changed after `updated_after`, including soft-deleted tombstones.

`coach-exercise-content` is read-only: it returns the custom exercise content and
YouTube videos uploaded by the coaches the user is actively enrolled with, shaped as
`CoachExerciseContentSync`. A coach removing both the image and the video produces a
tombstone. Content from coaches whose enrollment is no longer active is not returned.

200.description: Changed records and the requested resource name

post.summary: Pull changed flat-resource records in stable, paginated order
post.description:
The first request supplies the resources and their watermarks. Later requests
supply only the opaque `cursor` returned by the prior response. Nutrition-log
media is not available here.

200.description: A page of changed records. `next_cursor` is null on the final page.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: A client-generated, unique key. Repeating a completed request with the same key within 24 hours returns its original response without repeating the operation.

UpdatedAfter.name: updated_after
UpdatedAfter.description: Only return records changed after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

ValidationError.description: The request payload is invalid. Field-specific messages are returned in `errors`.

password: The password must be at least 12 characters.

Conflict.description: The requested identity cannot be linked.

id.description: Optional client-generated user id. Keeps records created locally before registration linked to the new user. Stored lowercased and must not already exist.

language.description: Preferred language used to generate the user’s first workout plan.

password.description: Must contain uppercase and lowercase letters, a number, a symbol, and must not appear in a known data leak.

id.description: Optional client-generated training preferences id, so syncing the locally created preferences doesn't duplicate the row. Stored lowercased and must not already exist.

authorization_code.description: Single-use authorization code returned by Apple's native authorization flow.

id_token.description: Google OpenID Connect ID token returned by Google Sign-In.
Google OpenID Connect ID token returned by Google Sign-In.

authorization_code.description: A newly issued, single-use Apple authorization code.

SyncRecord.description: A synced record. Besides the listed fields it carries the model's synced columns, including its relationship foreign keys (e.g. `user_id`, `workout_plan_id`, `workout_day_id`, `workout_block_id`, `planned_exercise_id`, `nutrition_plan_id`, `nutrition_day_id`, `nutrition_meal_id`).

ExerciseProfileSync.description: A user-owned profile for one catalog exercise. The optional `notes` field is private to that user and synced with `exercise-profiles`.

notes.description: User-private free-form notes for this exercise.

CoachExerciseContentSync.description: A coach's custom content for a catalog exercise. Use its image, video, and notes alongside the default catalog media when present; a null field falls back to the default.

image_url.description: Public URL of the JPEG image. Each upload gets a new URL, so it can be cached indefinitely.

notes.description: Coach-authored general guidance for this exercise, shared with the coach's active clients.

source_workout_day_id.description: The template this workout day was created from, if any.

daily_energy.description: Optional Apple Health daily energy for up to the last 21 days. Omit it when Apple Health is unavailable or not authorized; the server then uses the formula estimate.

date.description: Calendar day in the client time zone. Each date may appear once and must be between 22 days ago and tomorrow.

active_calories.description: Active energy burned that day, in kilocalories.

basal_calories.description: Resting energy burned that day, in kilocalories. Days without basal energy are ignored.

text.description: Free-text description of what the user ate.

meal_title.description: Optional meal context, for example Breakfast.

image.description: JPEG meal photo, up to 5 MB.

meal_title.description: Optional meal context, for example Lunch.

notes.description: Optional user context that may help estimate the meal.

front_image.description: A JPEG, PNG, GIF, HEIC, or HEIF image of the product front, up to 10 MiB.

nutrition_image.description: A JPEG, PNG, GIF, HEIC, or HEIF image of the nutrition label, up to 10 MiB.

canonicalFoodName.description: English canonical lookup name for the food.

kind.description: `template` is a reusable coach-owned workout day; `workout` is an executable workout day.
